questions.q: In ArduPilot 4.7.2 `OA_TYPE = 2` is set and an exclusion polygon is uploaded, but `FENCE_ENABLE = 0` at boot. What will the `OADJ` log show, and how will the vehicle fly?
options: `State = 2`, a detour around the zone with an `OA_MARGIN_MAX` margin
`State = 1`, a stop in front of the zone until the fence is enabled
Arming is refused with "Fence requires reboot"
questions.explain: Dijkstra checks `some_fences_enabled()` and without an enabled fence returns "not required": in SITL the track went through the square (`max |E|` 0.0 m).

questions.q: Weighted A* with a heuristic weight of w = 2 compared with plain A* on the same grid:
options: Expands more cells, but the path is always shorter
Expands fewer cells, the path is no longer than 2 × the optimal
Expands the same number of cells, the path is the same
Expands fewer cells and always finds the optimal path
questions.explain: Heuristic × w overestimates, so optimality is lost (in the "forest" 37.85 m against 33.56 m), but only 86 cells are expanded instead of 462; the guarantee is path ≤ w × optimal.
